# Purpose
This header file defines generated metric metadata for the gossip subsystem. It includes `fd_metrics_base.h` and `fd_metrics_enums.h`, then declares a set of `#define` constants that map each gossip metric name to its offset, type, description, and converter. The file covers counters and gauges for `gossip_ping_tracker`, `gossip_crds`, `gossip_contact_info`, and message transmit and receive statistics, including grouped submetrics with fixed index ranges. It ends with `FD_METRICS_GOSSIP_TOTAL` and an external declaration for the `FD_METRICS_GOSSIP` metadata array, which other code can use to access the full metric set.
